```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(icesSAG)
```

Results of ICES stock assessments are submitted to the Stock Assessment
Graphs (SAG) database as an XML file, uploaded at
<https://standardgraphs.ices.dk>.
The XML file is usually made with the SAG Excel template; this vignette
shows how to make the same file in R with **icesSAG**.

The example is the 2026 assessment of greater silver smelt (*Argentina
silus*) in divisions 5.b and 6.a (`aru.27.5b6a`), a category 1 stock assessed
with SAM.

The file is built from three pieces:

| Piece | Function | Excel template |
|---|---|---|
| Stock information and reference points | `stockInfo()` | top of the *FishData* sheet |
| Yearly results | `stockFishdata()` | the data table on the *FishData* sheet |
| Retrospective bias | `stockRetroBias()` | the *Retro-bias* sheet |

## Stock information

`stockInfo()` holds the stock code, assessment details, the descriptions and
units of the standard series, and any reference points.

```{r info}
info <- stockInfo(
  StockCode = "aru.27.5b6a",
  AssessmentYear = 2026,
  ContactPerson = "assessor@example.org",
  StockCategory = 1,
  Purpose = "Advice",
  ModelType = "A",
  ModelName = "SAM",
  Fage = "6-14",
  RecruitmentAge = 5,
  CatchesLandingsUnits = "t",
  RecruitmentDescription = "Recruitment",
  RecruitmentUnits = "NE3",
  FishingPressureDescription = "F",
  StockSizeDescription = "SSB",
  StockSizeUnits = "t",
  ConfidenceIntervalDefinition = "95%"
)
info
```

Coded entries must be valid codes in the ICES vocabularies:

| Argument | ICES vocabulary |
|---|---|
| `StockCode` | [ICES_StockCode](https://vocab.ices.dk/?ref=357) |
| `StockCategory` | [StockCategory](https://vocab.ices.dk/?ref=1526) |
| `Purpose` | [AssessmentPurpose](https://vocab.ices.dk/?ref=1516) |
| `ModelType` | [AssessmentModelType](https://vocab.ices.dk/?ref=1524) |
| `ModelName` | [AssessmentModelName](https://vocab.ices.dk/?ref=1525) |
| `...Units` | [MUNIT](https://vocab.ices.dk/?ref=155) |
| `CustomSeriesType1` to `20` | [StockDataType](https://vocab.ices.dk/?ref=1528) |

### Reference points

The reference points for this stock have not changed since the last
assessment, so none are given here and the file is written with
`sameRefPoints = TRUE` (see below). This is the same as the
"use the same reference points as last year" option in the Excel template.

If the reference points have changed, give them in `stockInfo()` and leave
`sameRefPoints = FALSE`. `BMSY` can be left out if it is not available;
`Flim` is no longer an ICES reference point and is not accepted.

```{r refpts, eval = FALSE}
info <- stockInfo(
  # ... as above, plus
  Blim = blim, Bpa = bpa, MSYBtrigger = msy_btrigger,
  FMSY = fmsy, Fpa = fpa, BMSY = bmsy
)
```

## Yearly results

Yearly results are usually already in a table. The results for this stock are
included in the package as a CSV file:

```{r read}
aru <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "aru.27.5b6a_2026.csv", package = "icesSAG"))
names(aru)
```

The column names must match the names in the upload format
(`Recruitment`, `Low_Recruitment`, `StockSize`, `FishingPressure`, ...);
columns with any other name are dropped with a warning. Empty cells are `NA`
and are left out of the file.

```{r fishdata}
fishdata <- do.call(stockFishdata, aru)
tail(fishdata[c("Year", "Recruitment", "StockSize", "Catches", "FishingPressure")])
```

The final year (2026) has only recruitment and SSB, as in the Excel template.

Custom series go in `CustomSeries1` to `CustomSeries20`, with the matching
`CustomSeriesName`, `CustomSeriesType` and `CustomSeriesUnits` given in
`stockInfo()`.

## Retrospective bias

Since 2026 the retro-bias record is mandatory for category 1 and 2 stocks.
Rho values are decimals, not percentages. `SSBrhoYear` and
`RecruitmentrhoYear` record whether the intermediate year was used as the
terminal year; `"Yes"`/`"No"` and `TRUE`/`FALSE` are converted to `"Y"`/`"N"`.

```{r retro}
retro <- stockRetroBias(
  TerminalYear = 2025,
  RetroAssessment = 5,
  Fbarrho = -0.1877,
  SSBrhoYear = "N",
  SSBrho = 0.0667,
  RecruitmentrhoYear = "N",
  Recruitmentrho = 0.0398
)
retro
```

## Checking and writing the file

`writeSAGxml()` checks the data and writes the file, named
`<StockCode>_<AssessmentYear>.xml` by default:

```{r write, eval = FALSE}
writeSAGxml(info, fishdata, retro, sameRefPoints = TRUE)
```

The checks (also available on their own as `checkSAG()`) compare coded
entries against the ICES vocabularies, which needs an internet connection,
and apply the same cross checks as DATSU and the Excel template. If there are
errors the file is not written and all the errors are listed together.
For example, with a lower case model name, no stock size units and no
retro-bias record:

```
Error: The file was not written, please fix the following errors:
  ModelName 'sam' is not a valid code in the ICES AssessmentModelName vocabulary
  StockSizeUnits is needed when StockSize is given
  the retro-bias record is mandatory for category 1 and 2 stocks, see stockRetroBias()
```

The checks can be skipped with `check = FALSE`, for example if the vocabulary
server cannot be reached, but the same checks are applied when the file is
uploaded.

## The file

```{r show, echo = FALSE}
file <- writeSAGxml(info, fishdata, retro, sameRefPoints = TRUE,
                    file = tempfile(fileext = ".xml"), check = FALSE)
xml <- readLines(file)
```

The start of the file holds the stock information:

```{r head, echo = FALSE, comment = ""}
first <- grep("<Fish_Data>", xml)[1]
cat(xml[1:(first - 1)], sep = "\n")
```

followed by one `Fish_Data` record per year, and at the end the retro-bias
record and the reference point setting:

```{r tail, echo = FALSE, comment = ""}
last <- max(grep("<Fish_Data>", xml))
cat(xml[last:length(xml)], sep = "\n")
```

## Uploading

Upload the file at <https://standardgraphs.ices.dk>. The file is screened
on upload and any errors are reported.
